name: Xuemei Wu
abstract_title: “DeepSeek Chinese Emotion Challenge” and the Possible Essential way: A Coexistence-Predictive AI Approach
abstract: Currently, how to tackle the “DeepSeek Chinese Emotion Challenge” constitutes a major challenge for the AI community, necessitating philosophical exploration of potential solutions. Based on DeepSeek’s predictive characteristics, we find that the emotion theory it employs leans towards the Theory of Predictive Mind-Constructed Emotion.
